rawFindings.title: Populate now silently queries the wrong collection when no ref is defined
rawFindings.explanation: The new fallback to `model.modelName` means `populate()` no longer errors when a path has no `ref` and no `options.model`. For example, `User.find().populate('missingRefPath')` will now issue a query against the current model name instead of failing fast, and populate the path with unrelated documents or `null` results.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the guard for missing model names, or only apply the `model.modelName` fallback when the populated value is an ad-hoc model that was explicitly bound to a known collection.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Calling `someModel.populate(doc, [{ path: 'untypedPath' }], cb)` on a schema path without `ref` now completes without an error and queries `someModel`'s collection instead of returning the previous 'unable to determine model name' error.
